backend/main.mo: Defines an actor storing inquiries in memory, validates input, and exposes submitInquiry and getAllInquiries methods.
backend/migration.mo: Provides a simple migration that copies the inquiries array from the old actor state to the new one.
feature_evidence.json: Contains metadata describing a feature requirement linking backend inquiry APIs to specific frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists short summaries of various frontend files, describing their roles and UI behaviors.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind-based theme variables and base styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting up fonts and loading the main React script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures the TanStack Router with all app routes and wraps them in the main layout.
frontend/src/components/CategoryHierarch: Renders a grid of subcategory buttons with navigation and reveal animations.
frontend/src/components/ProductQuickView: Implements a modal for quick product previews with image, details, and a send-inquiry button.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Displays the site footer with branding, links, contact info, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive header with navigation, scroll styling, and mobile menu toggle using router navigation.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Page layout wrapper rendering header, footer, and routed content via Outlet.
Card component generating product descriptions and placeholder images with reveal animations.
frontend/src/data/productTaxonomy.ts: Defines product category taxonomy with nested categories, subcategories, and product types.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, logout, identity loading, and status management.
frontend/src/hooks/useParallax.ts: Hook applying parallax scrolling effects unless reduced-motion is preferred.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines inquiry submission and retrieval queries using the backend actor and react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useReducedMotion.ts: Hook detecting user preference for reduced motion via media query.
frontend/src/hooks/useRevealOnce.ts: Hook revealing an element once upon intersection using IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, theme color variables, dark mode overrides, and custom styles for page wrappers and UI elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and imports global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with sections for mission, values, and company highlights using styled components and icons.
frontend/src/pages/CataloguePage.tsx: Implements a catalogue request form with validation, submission handling, and a confirmation screen.
frontend/src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx: Displays a product category with banner, navigation, customization note, and subcategory hierarchy; handles invalid slugs.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Provides a contact form with category selection, validation, inquiry submission, and a success message.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero image, parallax effects, reveal-on-scroll animations, and navigation buttons to products and catalogue.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Displays product categories in a grid, each linking to its category page using router navigation.
frontend/src/pages/SubcategoryPage.tsx: Shows products within a subcategory, handles navigation, product selection, and displays a banner and inquiry actions.
frontend/src/utils/slug.ts: Provides helper functions to convert strings to URL slugs and back.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Tracks overall project state, feature requests, and backend-related requirements for inquiry handling.
